evidence_required: Static proof that production code contains no current provider factory, provider-specific SDK import, binding environment variable, credential lookup, endpoint selection, or real-model smoke path.
Focused deterministic tests proving generic test-only executor injection and fail-closed unbound Agent Runtime and Vision behavior before network I/O.
Regression evidence for exact outbound request/media identity, strict result validation, no fallback/fake production output, and unchanged roster/bootstrap behavior.
Task-level independent verify, red-verify, and exact HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done before closure.
purpose: Make the implementation match the accepted provider-neutral code-phase contract by removing premature provider selection and retaining only narrow executor seams plus fail-closed production behavior.
success_outcome: Production has no selected provider, model, endpoint, credentials, egress switch, provider SDK composition, or live smoke; Agent Runtime and Vision still accept explicit test-only executors and otherwise return their stable not-configured outcome before I/O.
anti_goals: Do not select or design a replacement provider, endpoint, model, authentication mode, credential source, egress field, timeout policy, or cost budget.
Do not add an unbound executor class, replacement provider registry/factory, compatibility shim, or new lifecycle/state.
Do not change public HTTP contracts, database schema, roster/bootstrap behavior, model request/result schemas, MessageEnvelope semantics, or downstream authority.
Do not rewrite terminal TASK-028 through TASK-034 protocols or evidence.

forbidden_scope: Any provider, model, base URL, authentication, credential, egress, timeout, budget, or live-network selection.
Public API, database migration/storage, Agent Runtime request/result/envelope shape, roster/bootstrap, Safety, Task, Companion, Bus, UI, or Plant-state behavior changes.
New production fake/canned/fallback executor or a replacement abstraction for the deleted provider composition.
Historical task lifecycle, protocol, verification, red-verification, or closure evidence.
stop_conditions: A current production caller is found to require the provider factory or provider-specific configuration.
Removing provider-specific code requires changing a public API, database state, accepted model request/result contract, or downstream authority.
A provider/model/endpoint/auth/config choice is required to complete deterministic code-phase behavior.
Work outside the explicit write boundary is required for the task outcome.

constraints: Production composition expresses the accepted unbound state by omitting an executor; services return the existing stable not-configured result before I/O.

Keep provider-neutral ModelExecutor and VisionModelExecutor protocols, strict request/result validation, test-only fake/spy dependency injection, timeout/error normalization, redaction, and no-fallback behavior.
Vision executor model_ref validation may enforce only the generic safe provider:model grammar; it must not select or privilege Gemini or another provider.
Remove only dependencies, configuration, tests, and documentation whose sole current purpose is the unselected provider composition or live smoke.
invariants: No production path selects a fake, provider, model, endpoint, credential, egress permission, or fallback.
No model output gains direct Plant-state, Safety, Task, governance, publication, or actuation authority.
Typed outbound request/media allowlists, authorization guards, result schemas, MessageEnvelope semantics, audit redaction, and roster/bootstrap behavior remain unchanged.
A future selected-endpoint milestone remains the sole owner of provider-specific configuration and integration evidence.
verification_targets: Focused Agent Runtime and Vision suites pass without a real_model marker or network prerequisites.
Static scans find no production import of provider-specific SDKs, no provider binding/egress environment fields, and no DeepSeek/Gemini/ChatGPT OAuth composition.
Unbound service tests prove the stable not-configured result and zero executor/network calls.
Vision spy tests retain exact accepted-photo bytes/content-type/source-ref/sha256 identity with a generic test-scoped model_ref.
